    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if (0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w
                            and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            comps.append((color, cells))

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    # The objects are moved to the lower part of the canvas, preserving
    # their shapes; order them in the same order as they occur in the input.
    comps.sort(key=lambda z: min(r for r, c in z[1]))
    for color, cells in comps:
        minr = min(r for r, c in cells)
        minc = min(c for r, c in cells)
        maxr = max(r for r, c in cells)
        maxc = max(c for r, c in cells)
        # Place objects downwards, keeping their horizontal location where possible.
        shift = h - 1 - maxr
        for r, c in cells:
            rr, cc = r + shift, c
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == 0:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
